## 1. Sourcing

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
tidymodels_prefer()

train <- read_csv("train.csv")
```

## 2. Plots

### a) Data Setup

```{r}
train <-
  train %>%
  mutate(q_demos_state  = factor(q_demos_state),
         year = factor(year),
         month = factor(month))

var_names <- colnames(train)[-5]
log_var_names <- var_names[!var_names %in% c("q_demos_state", "year", "month")]
```

### b) No Transform

```{r, cache = TRUE}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for(i in var_names) {
  plot(train$order_totals ~ train[[i]],
       ylab = "order_totals",
       xlab = i)
}
```

### c) Standard Plot

```{r, cache = TRUE}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for(i in var_names) {
  plot(train$log_total ~ train[[i]],
       ylab = "log_total",
       xlab = i)
}
```

### d) Log Transformation

```{r, cache = TRUE}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for(i in log_var_names) {
  plot(train$log_total ~ log(train[[i]]),
       ylab = "log_total",
       xlab = i)
}
```

### e) Correlation Matrix

```{r}
train_cor <- train %>% select(- c("q_demos_state", "year", "month"))
cor(train_cor)
```

## 3. Config Final Output

### a) Log Transform

```{r, cache = TRUE}
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))
for(i in log_var_names) {
  plot(train$log_total ~ log(train[[i]]),
       main = i,
       ylab = "log_total",
       xlab = i)
}
```

### b) Histogram

```{r, cache = TRUE}
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))
for(i in log_var_names) {
  hist(log(train[[i]]),
       main = i,
       xlab = i,
       ylab = "log_total",
       col = "darkviolet")
}
```

### c) Counts Check

```{r}
sum(train$count_lessHS)
sum(train$count_HS)
sum(train$count_B)
sum(train$count_G)
```
